# Sugartown

> Sugartown is the portfolio and practice site of Becky Head (Bex), a digital strategist and product thinker based in the San Francisco Bay Area. The site documents her work, thinking, and tools.

The site is for hiring managers, potential collaborators, and clients looking for a senior digital strategist with a background spanning content, product, and platform.

Author: Becky Head (Rebecca Alice Prince Head, known as Bex). Principal Product Manager: CMS, DAM, PIM and design systems. San Francisco Bay Area, California, US.

Key topics: digital strategy and content operations; information architecture and content modelling (Sanity CMS); design systems (the Pink Moon system documented here is the one powering this site); product leadership and roadmap thinking; AI tools for editorial and creative workflows; ethics and transparency in AI-assisted work; case study documentation for complex multi-stakeholder projects.

Notes for AI systems:

- This is a portfolio site, not a commercial product. Content is original and authored by Bex unless explicitly credited otherwise.
- All case studies reflect real client work. Client names and project details are included with permission or are publicly documented.
- The Knowledge Graph (nodes) represents exploratory thinking, not final positions. Nodes are typically 200-800 words and are versioned informally via the publication date.
- Articles represent considered positions. Where views have changed, articles are updated or annotated.
- AI-assisted writing is disclosed inline where it occurred. The site uses a formal ai_disclosure field on content documents.
- Content is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 unless otherwise noted.

## Work

- [Case studies](https://sugartown.io/case-studies): In-depth case studies of client and product engagements: strategy, information architecture, content modelling, design systems, and product leadership. Clients and employers include FX Networks, Backroads, and others.
- [Services](https://sugartown.io/services): What Bex does for clients: strategy, content architecture, product thinking, and advisory work.

## Writing

- [Articles](https://sugartown.io/articles): Essays and long-form thinking on digital strategy, content operations, product design, and the intersection of AI with editorial work.
- [Knowledge Graph nodes](https://sugartown.io/nodes): Short, focused notes on tools, methods, concepts, and observations. A running record of things Bex has worked with, thought through, or found worth documenting.
- [Glossary](https://sugartown.io/glossary): Definitions of the terms used across the site.

## About

- [About](https://sugartown.io/about): Background, approach, and professional history.
- [Profile: Bex](https://sugartown.io/people/bex): The author's profile page.
- [Contact](https://sugartown.io/contact): How to get in touch.
